messages:
dylan: quick idea for onboarding: introduce 'tracelets' - tiny deterministic traces that exercise tokenization, kv-cache, and attention edgecases in isolation. super cheap and run during admit/canary.
riya: how are these different from golden samples + mini-bench?
kevin: golden samples validate semantics, mini-bench measures perf on longer inputs. tracelets are focused step-by-step sequences (think unit tests) for runtime behaviors.
sarah: so they help catch kv-cache alignment, off-by-one tokenization, small numeric drift?
dylan: yep. designed to detect micro-latency regressions and runtime correctness that full text compares might miss.
matt: can we include them in the model manifest so every model can ship a few?
kevin: proposal: manifest adds a small list. example snippet: ```{ "tracelets": [ { "id": "kv-rotate-16", "seq": ["Hello", " world", "\nexpand"], "assert": "tokens-alignment,kv-checksum", "max_latency_ms": "50" } ] }```
riya: we should constrain asserts to structure, token boundaries, and simple numeric checks. no brittle full-text equality.
sarah: trust boundary: third-party tracelets could run arbitrary work. mark them verified/unverified in manifest. only run unverified in isolated smokehouse or slowpath.
dylan: manifest flag: tracelets: verified|unverified. default unverified.
bench-bot: queued run for model foo/v2 tracelets on canary pool in 10m.
matt: where do we store results? console needs quick diffs.
kevin: store a compact run summary in the registry: pass/fail, p50/p99 latency, kv-checksum. keep full logs for 7 days.
riya: rollout semantics idea: run tracelets at admit (fast), continuously on canary (cheap checks), and when upgrading runtime/kernel on Dedicated.
sarah: tradeoffs: potential noise from flaky asserts and false positives.
dylan: mitigation: assertion confidence level + re-run threshold. default re-run n=3 before raising an alert.
matt: also provide `runtest tracelet <model> --local` for dev repro.
kevin: integrate into existing smokehouse runner so infra reuse is minimal.
riya: blockers: update onboarding docs, manifest schema, and implement a lightweight verifier. console UX for diffs too.
dylan: i'll draft a small RFC follow-up with manifest changes, allowed assert set, run semantics, and storage policy. aiming to post by EOD.
sarah: add an emergency fallback: if a verified tracelet fails on canary, auto-fallback to previous runtime/kernel variant until we investigate.
dylan: noted. bench-bot, plz post results here when done.
bench-bot: run started, will return summary in thread when complete.
